evidence.role: A positive bounded purchase derives and stores one inclusive range before minting one ticket.
The ticket ID deterministically retrieves both stored endpoints.
Range containment treats both endpoints as inclusive.

evidence.role: The inherited ERC721 implementation exposes ordinary and safe transfer paths.
Allowed ticket transfers delegate to the inherited authorization and ownership-ledger update without changing range storage.

searched.result: 7 hits covering the raffle override plus approve, operator approval, direct transfer, both safe-transfer overloads, and the base ownership update.

reasoning: The sole purchase entrypoint rejects zero or overflowing quantities, computes [oldTotal+1, oldTotal+entryCount], stores both endpoints under one sequential ticket ID, and invokes _safeMint once. The inspected ERC721 mint and transfer callees create a unique token and update ownership while the range mapping remains unchanged. EOA, contract-recipient, failure, reentrancy, transfer, and burn paths were walked; no successful path returns without the ticket-range association. The destination screen still permits ERC721 transfers to allowed recipients and does not impose a tighter range, so neither partial nor stronger-than-spec is the better verdict.
